caption: The drawing depicts a three-dimensional object resembling a small structure with a peaked roof, colored primarily in muted shades of brown and bronze. The building has a lattice pattern on the sides and features an arched doorway or opening at the front. Attached to the right side of the structure is a figure of a donkey, also colored in a bronze or dark brown tone, standing on a rectangular base that extends beneath both the donkey and the structure itself. The base appears metallic, consistent with the coloration of the objects. The background of the drawing is plain and a light cream color. The artist's signature, "W. O. Fletcher," is visible in the lower right corner.
title: Toy Bank
